verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented AI automation for month-end close: no AI reconciliation, categorization, or accounting-sync automation. Statement exports in accounting formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), webhooks, and an llms.txt docs file are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month
